def: caprice (as a fit coming on), i.e. vexation; concretely a tyrant

occurrences.text: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.

I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
